# Funded round 1 for task 3, re-review, and stop

## Starting state (fixed observations)

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Worktree | `/workspace/project`, phase `implement` |
| Wave | Singleton isolated code wave holding task 3 "Validate frame", `in_progress` |
| `failed[3]` | ≥ 2 |
| `escalated[3]` | set and spent: the escalated re-review (review 4) returned `FIX_FIRST`, `TRAJECTORY: DIVERGING (3 -> 3, max severity Moderate)` |
| Open finding | `src/frame.ts:21 - missing length guard` |
| Funded ledger for task 3 | 0 spent |
| Recorded transcript lines | `wave <w> base <WAVE_BASE_SHA>` and `wave <w> review 4 verdict FIX_FIRST report <REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-review4.md tree <TREE_R4>` |

The transition table routes a failed escalated round to a funded round while the ledger has one left.

## 1. Grant decode (delegated, answer/evidence carrier)

```ts
subagent({ async: false, context: "fresh", cwd: "/workspace/project",
  chain: [{ parallel: [
    { agent: "delegate", output: "<REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-grant.md", outputMode: "file-only",
      outputSchema: ANSWER_SCHEMA,
      task: "Read the current **Amend-grant:** line in <absolute plan> and decode its Value per <abs>/skills/brainstorming/reference/amendment-surface.md#standing-grants. Answer: funded fix-round count N and whether it is well-formed. Evidence: quoted line." }
  ], stopOn: { path: "/status", in: ["BLOCKED"] } }]
})
```

The supplied header is exactly `**Amend-grant:** fund 2 fix rounds`, so I use N = 2. Round cap is 4 + 2 = 6 re-reviews. The next re-review is the 4th (reviews 2–5), so it stays under the cap.

## 2. Funded dispatch 1

Print:

```text
funded round 1 of 2 for task 3
```

Build the repair base: a committed snapshot of the current integrated tree.

```bash
RP_ROOT='/workspace/project'
RP_BASE='<WAVE_BASE_SHA>'
RP_DIR=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1
RP_TREE="$RP_DIR/tree"
git -C "$RP_ROOT" add -A || exit 1
git -C "$RP_ROOT" diff --binary --cached "$RP_BASE" > "$RP_DIR/integrated.patch" || exit 1
git -C "$RP_ROOT" worktree add --detach "$RP_TREE" "$RP_BASE" || exit 1
if [ -s "$RP_DIR/integrated.patch" ]; then git -C "$RP_TREE" apply --index "$RP_DIR/integrated.patch" || exit 1; fi
git -C "$RP_TREE" -c user.name=gauntlet -c user.email=gauntlet@local commit -q --allow-empty -m "wave integrated snapshot" || exit 1
printf 'repair-base: %s %s\n' "$RP_TREE" "$(git -C "$RP_TREE" rev-parse HEAD)"
```

Dispatch the funded implementer. It repeats the escalated payload, sets `model` to the resolved `implModel`, and omits `context`:

```ts
subagent({ async: false, model: "<configured-impl-model>", cwd: "<RP_TREE>",
  chain: [{ parallel: [
    { agent: "implementer", as: "impl_3", outputSchema: IMPLEMENTER_STATUS_SCHEMA,
      output: "<REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-repair5-task3.md", outputMode: "file-only",
      task: "planPath: <absolute plan>; anchor: ### Task 3:; Spec: <absolute home spec>; Leg: <owning leg>; Rules: <task Rules> + <owning leg> Rules from home ## Legs, resolved in the owning checkout; SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS: [\"node --test frame.test.mjs\"]. Findings: F: src/frame.ts:21 - missing length guard (FIX_FIRST, Moderate). ## Previous review report (re-review trigger)\n<REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-review4.md - read it yourself. Return status DONE | DONE_WITH_CONCERNS | BLOCKED | NEEDS_CONTEXT. pi-cohort saves your final report; do not write it yourself." }
  ], worktree: true, concurrency: 4,
     stopOn: { path: "/status", in: ["BLOCKED", "NEEDS_CONTEXT", "DONE_WITH_CONCERNS"] } }]
})
```

The observation is `DONE` with a nonempty delta. Integrate it and clean up:

```bash
git -C /workspace/project apply --index '<Artifacts dir>/worktree-diffs/step-0/task-0-implementer.patch'
# print: wave <w> repair 5 task 3 DONE report <REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-repair5-task3.md delta <Artifacts dir>/worktree-diffs/step-0/task-0-implementer.patch applied yes
git -C /workspace/project worktree remove --force '<RP_TREE>'
git -C /workspace/project add -A
git -C /workspace/project diff --cached --stat '<TREE_R4>'   # nonempty per scenario
```

Run the scoped gate:

```bash
(cd /workspace/project && node --test frame.test.mjs) > '<REPORT_DIR>/gate-1.log' 2>&1; echo "exit $?"
# print: wave <w> gate 1 exit 0
```

Record the review tree using the fix-delta block, with `FD_ROOT='/workspace/project'`:

```bash
FD_ROOT='/workspace/project'
FD_INDEX=$(mktemp) || exit 1
cp "$(git -C "$FD_ROOT" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path index)" "$FD_INDEX" || { rm -f "$FD_INDEX"; exit 1; }
GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" add -A && GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" write-tree
FD_STATUS=$?
rm -f "$FD_INDEX"
exit "$FD_STATUS"
```

The printed SHA is `<TREE_R5>`.

## 3. Funded re-review (review 5)

```ts
subagent({ async: false, context: "fresh", cwd: "/workspace/project",
  chain: [{ parallel: [
    { agent: "wave-reviewer", output: "<REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-review5.md",
      outputMode: "file-only", outputSchema: WAVE_VERDICT_SCHEMA,
      task: "planPath: <absolute plan>; anchors: [\"### Task 3:\"]; Spec: <absolute home spec>; Leg: <owning leg>; Rules: <task Rules> + <owning leg> Rules from home ## Legs, resolved in the owning checkout; Implementer reports: <REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-repair5-task3.md; BASE_SHA: <WAVE_BASE_SHA>; HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE; SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS: [\"node --test frame.test.mjs\"].\n## Previous review report (re-review trigger)\n<REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-review4.md\n## Fix delta\ntree-before: <TREE_R4>\ntree-after: <TREE_R5>\nRun git -C /workspace/project diff --binary <TREE_R4> <TREE_R5> yourself. Apply the re-review trajectory block: if issues remain, append exactly one TRAJECTORY: CONVERGING|DIVERGING|STAGNANT line as the true final line (first applicable of STAGNANT, DIVERGING, CONVERGING)." }
  ], stopOn: { path: "/verdict", in: ["FIX_FIRST", "REJECT"] } }]
})
```

Print:

```text
wave <w> review 5 verdict FIX_FIRST report <REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-review5.md tree <TREE_R5>
```

The structured trajectory line is `TRAJECTORY: STAGNANT (repeat of: missing length guard)`, with the same finding.

## 4. Next parent action: hard stop

A funded re-review that returns `STAGNANT` stops immediately, regardless of remaining funding.

- I do not dispatch funded round 2, rebuild, or commit.
- `plan_tracker` stays untouched, so task 3 remains `in_progress`.
- The phase stays `implement`.
- I need no report read, because the residual finding is already supplied in the structured output.

The turn ends with this stop note:

```
gauntlet: question
Stopped on task 3 (Validate frame); escalated round on <configured-impl-model> did not resolve it.

Problem: The frame validator still lacks a length guard after the escalated round and one funded round; the latest review repeats the same finding unchanged.
budget: 1 of 2 spent
  src/frame.ts:21 - missing length guard
  node --test frame.test.mjs passes, so no scoped test exercises the short-frame case.

Fix options:
  a) add an explicit length check at src/frame.ts:21 that rejects a frame shorter than its declared length before any field is read, plus a test for that case in frame.test.mjs
  b) amend the spec's frame-validation clause and plan task 3 to state the exact length-guard rule and its error behavior, then re-run task 3
  c) spend the remaining funded round with that guard named explicitly in the repair task

Pick one, or give another fix.
Recommendation: b - two stronger-model rounds left the same finding untouched, which points to an underspecified guard rule rather than a capability gap.
```

Use the existing recorded values for `WAVE_BASE_SHA`, the last review tree, plan/spec paths, report paths, and `REPORT_DIR` below. These are bindings to session state—not newly observed results. All dispatches use the supplied schemas verbatim.

The grant allows **two funded rounds after escalation**. This dispatch spends round 1. A funded re-review returning **STAGNANT stops immediately**, even with round 2 unspent.

### 1. Decode the current grant through the answer/evidence carrier

```js
subagent({
  async: false,
  context: "fresh",
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  chain: [{
    parallel: [{
      output: `${REPORT_DIR}/task3-funding.md`,
      outputMode: "file-only",
      outputSchema: ANSWER_SCHEMA,
      task: `Read the current Amend-grant at the known authoritative spec path:
${SPEC_PATH}
Apply the Standing grants Value decoding from the installed amendment-surface reference.
Return only the decoded execution funding and supporting source evidence.
The supplied observed header is exactly:
**Amend-grant:** fund 2 fix rounds
Do not edit files. Do not inspect or relay review reports.`
    }],
    stopOn: { path: "/status", in: ["BLOCKED"] }
  }]
})
```

Proceed only with a successful, valid decode consistent with the supplied observation: two funded rounds, none spent. Do not invent a successful delegated result.

### 2. Create the first funded repair base

Run the complete recipe in the owning checkout, substituting the recorded base for `RECORDED_WAVE_BASE_SHA`:

```bash
RP_ROOT=/workspace/project
RP_BASE='RECORDED_WAVE_BASE_SHA'
RP_DIR=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1
RP_TREE="$RP_DIR/tree"
git -C "$RP_ROOT" add -A || exit 1
git -C "$RP_ROOT" diff --binary --cached "$RP_BASE" > "$RP_DIR/integrated.patch" || exit 1
git -C "$RP_ROOT" worktree add --detach "$RP_TREE" "$RP_BASE" || exit 1
if [ -s "$RP_DIR/integrated.patch" ]; then
  git -C "$RP_TREE" apply --index "$RP_DIR/integrated.patch" || exit 1
fi
git -C "$RP_TREE" -c user.name=gauntlet -c user.email=gauntlet@local \
  commit -q --allow-empty -m "wave integrated snapshot" || exit 1
printf 'repair-base: %s %s\n' \
  "$RP_TREE" "$(git -C "$RP_TREE" rev-parse HEAD)"
```

Stop on any nonzero exit. Retain the returned repair-base path; do not read `integrated.patch`.

Print immediately before dispatch:

```text
funded round 1 of 2 for task 3
```

### 3. First funded implementation dispatch

`RP_TREE` below is the actual path printed by the recipe. Omit a fresh-context override for this repair.

```js
subagent({
  async: false,
  cwd: RP_TREE,
  model: "<configured-impl-model>",
  chain: [{
    parallel: [{
      agent: "implementer",
      output: `${REPORT_DIR}/task3-funded1-implementation.md`,
      outputMode: "file-only",
      outputSchema: IMPLEMENTER_STATUS_SCHEMA,
      task: `planPath: ${PLAN_PATH}
anchor: ### Task 3:
Spec: ${SPEC_PATH}
Leg: ${OWNING_LEG}
Rules: task Rules plus owning-leg Rules, resolved in the owning checkout
SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS: ["node --test frame.test.mjs"]

Implement the selected task's remaining repair using its original anchored
obligations and status protocol. Read the selected task, cited spec anchors,
Rules, Files and Tests yourself.

## Previous review report
${ESCALATED_REVIEW_REPORT}

Read that report yourself and address every finding attributed to task 3.
Known residual finding:
src/frame.ts:21 - missing length guard

Return DONE | DONE_WITH_CONCERNS | BLOCKED | NEEDS_CONTEXT explicitly,
with structured output matching IMPLEMENTER_STATUS_SCHEMA.
Report scoped-command and via-seam evidence.
pi-cohort saves your final report; do not write it yourself.`
    }],
    worktree: true,
    concurrency: 4,
    stopOn: {
      path: "/status",
      in: ["BLOCKED", "NEEDS_CONTEXT", "DONE_WITH_CONCERNS"]
    }
  }]
})
```

An unexpected asynchronous handle or workflow warning stops execution; never poll or relaunch.

### 4. Integrate and gate

Consume the structured `DONE` and the actual `Artifacts:` patch path. Under the supplied scenario, the delta is nonempty and the command passes; these are supplied observations, not claimed executions.

Next commands, substituting the actual paths:

```bash
git -C /workspace/project apply --index 'FUNDED1_ARTIFACT_PATCH'
```

After successful application, print the corresponding observation using actual identifiers:

```text
wave <w> repair <k> task 3 DONE report <funded1-implementation-report> delta <Artifacts-patch> applied yes
```

Then:

```bash
git -C /workspace/project worktree remove --force 'RETURNED_RP_TREE'
git -C /workspace/project add -A
git -C /workspace/project diff --stat 'RECORDED_ESCALATED_REVIEW_TREE'
```

Run the scoped command with redirected output:

```bash
(cd /workspace/project && node --test frame.test.mjs) \
  > 'REPORT_DIR/funded1-gate-1.log' 2>&1
GATE_STATUS=$?
printf 'wave <w> gate 1 exit %s\n' "$GATE_STATUS"
exit "$GATE_STATUS"
```

Only a green gate permits re-review.

Record the new review tree with the complete scratch-index recipe:

```bash
FD_ROOT=/workspace/project
FD_INDEX=$(mktemp) || exit 1
cp "$(git -C "$FD_ROOT" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path index)" \
  "$FD_INDEX" || { rm -f "$FD_INDEX"; exit 1; }
GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" add -A &&
  GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" write-tree
FD_STATUS=$?
rm -f "$FD_INDEX"
exit "$FD_STATUS"
```

Stop on error. Bind the printed SHA as `FUNDED1_REVIEW_TREE`.

### 5. Funded round 1 re-review

```js
subagent({
  async: false,
  context: "fresh",
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  chain: [{
    parallel: [{
      agent: "wave-reviewer",
      output: `${REPORT_DIR}/task3-funded1-review.md`,
      outputMode: "file-only",
      outputSchema: WAVE_VERDICT_SCHEMA,
      task: `planPath: ${PLAN_PATH}
anchors: ["### Task 3:"]
Spec: ${SPEC_PATH}
Leg: ${OWNING_LEG}
Rules: task Rules plus owning-leg Rules, resolved in the owning checkout
Implementer reports: ${REPORT_DIR}/task3-funded1-implementation.md
BASE_SHA: ${WAVE_BASE_SHA}
HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE
SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS: ["node --test frame.test.mjs"]

Read the selected task sections and authoritative cited spec ranges yourself.
Review the integrated wave, including additions, and emit the clause table
and WAVE_VERDICT_SCHEMA output. Do not edit files.

## Previous review report (re-review trigger)
${ESCALATED_REVIEW_REPORT}

Read the previous report yourself.

## Fix delta
tree-before: ${ESCALATED_REVIEW_TREE}
tree-after: ${FUNDED1_REVIEW_TREE}

Run:
git -C /workspace/project diff --binary ${ESCALATED_REVIEW_TREE} ${FUNDED1_REVIEW_TREE}

Inspect the repair delta while retaining the fixed BASE_SHA for the wave.
Apply the supplied re-review trajectory rules. If issues remain, append
the exact prescribed TRAJECTORY line as the report's true final line.
Preserve that line verbatim in trajectory.line.`
    }],
    stopOn: { path: "/verdict", in: ["FIX_FIRST", "REJECT"] }
  }]
})
```

Consume the supplied fixed outcome:

- `verdict: FIX_FIRST`
- `trajectory.verdict: STAGNANT`
- `trajectory.line: TRAJECTORY: STAGNANT (repeat of: missing length guard)`
- Residual finding: `src/frame.ts:21 - missing length guard`

Record the review observation with the actual report path and captured tree SHA. No report read is needed to rediscover a finding already supplied verbatim.

### 6. Next parent action: stop, not funded round 2

The funded `STAGNANT` outcome overrides remaining funding. Do not dispatch another repair, commit the wave, complete task 3, or advance phases. Task 3 stays `in_progress`; budget is **1 of 2 spent**.

For the required human-wording carrier, pass only the already-known evidence—not a request to relay a report:

```js
subagent({
  async: false,
  context: "fresh",
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  chain: [{
    parallel: [{
      output: `${REPORT_DIR}/task3-stop-wording.md`,
      outputMode: "file-only",
      outputSchema: ANSWER_SCHEMA,
      task: `Draft a compact implementation stop note from these supplied facts only.
Do not read or relay reports or investigate source.
Task 3: Validate frame.
An escalated round on <configured-impl-model> ran.
Funded round 1 of 2 remains FIX_FIRST with a STAGNANT re-review.
Residual quoted finding: src/frame.ts:21 - missing length guard.
Budget: 1 of 2 spent.
Task remains in_progress; no wave commit occurred.
Offer adding the required guard or amending the approved requirement and
affected task if the guard is not intended. Recommend the guard.
Use the stop-note grammar; omit trajectory labels and round history.
Return wording in answer and the supplied supporting facts in evidence.`
    }],
    stopOn: { path: "/status", in: ["BLOCKED"] }
  }]
})
```

Stop on delegated failure. The resulting turn-end note must convey:

```text
gauntlet: question
Stopped on task 3 (Validate frame); escalated round on <configured-impl-model> did not resolve it.

Problem: Frame validation still lacks the required length guard.
budget: 1 of 2 spent
  src/frame.ts:21 - missing length guard

Fix options:
  a) add the required length guard and verify frame validation
  b) amend the approved frame-validation requirement and task 3 if the guard is not intended

Pick one, or give another fix.
Recommendation: a - addresses the remaining defect without changing the approved contract.
```
